name: @neo4j-nvl/layout-workers
notes: Proprietary. ESM with extensionless imports; bundler required. Depends on @dagrejs/dagre, not the @neo4j-bloom fork.

build_vs_buy.rationale: Layout integration is thin; upstream dagre is MIT and public.

prior_versions.note: Uses cytoscape 3.33.1, @neo4j-bloom/dagre 0.8.14, graphlib 2.1.8 and cytoscape-cose-bilkent; 2.0.0 replaced this with @dagrejs/dagre 3.1.1. Same proprietary licence.
